capabilities.name: Procedural memory (production rules / skills)
capabilities.notes: Policies are fixed, not learned production rules. Policy selection is active inference, not pattern matching.

capabilities.name: Declarative memory (facts / episodes)
capabilities.evidence: store/ltm.rs (LTM episodic store with SDR encoding)
capabilities.notes: Episodic store with salience-gated encoding, emotional tagging, and SDR-based retrieval. Verified in bench_memory_boundedness.

capabilities.name: Working memory (active state)
capabilities.notes: The core state struct is the working memory — shared across processes via mmap, updated every tick.

capabilities.name: Perceptual modules (sensory input)
capabilities.notes: Interoception reads CPU temp, load, memory, I/O, battery and maps them to neurochemical impulses. This is the machine-native perceptual system.

capabilities.name: Motor modules (action output)
capabilities.notes: Body control publishes CPU frequency, scheduling priority, I/O priority, and thermal caps. Applied via cognitive mind.

capabilities.name: Learning mechanism
capabilities.notes: The active inference engine learns an 18×18 transition matrix and adapts precision. Verified in bench_learning_curves.

capabilities.name: Decision-making (action selection)
capabilities.notes: Policy selection minimizes expected free energy, balancing pragmatic cost and epistemic value. Verified in bench_epistemic_foraging.

capabilities.name: Goal-directed behavior
capabilities.notes: Goals are implicit (homeostatic baselines), not explicit goal representations. No goal stack or goal decomposition.

capabilities.name: Attention mechanism
capabilities.notes: Acetylcholine gates cortical processing; norepinephrine modulates focus. These are neurochemically grounded.

capabilities.name: Emotion / affect
capabilities.notes: Full neurochemical affective system with arousal, valence, and specific neuromodulators. Verified in bench_cortisol_hpa, bench_dopamine_rpe.

capabilities.name: Autonomous learning (without external teaching)
capabilities.notes: The engine learns its own transition model from observed neurochemical trajectories — no external teacher.

capabilities.name: Representation development (builds own representations)
capabilities.notes: Episodes are encoded as sparse distributed representations. The active inference engine builds a transition model. But no concept formation or abstraction layer.

capabilities.name: Domain independence (not task-specific)
capabilities.notes: The neurochemical substrate is domain-general (it models the system's own state, not a specific task). But the policy repertoire is fixed and domain-specific (homeostatic).

capabilities.name: Self-modification (changes own architecture)
capabilities.notes: The coupling matrix is plastic (metaplasticity), receptors adapt, and BDNF gates plasticity. The system modifies its own dynamics.

capabilities.name: Scalability (handles increasing complexity)
capabilities.notes: FE scales 1.29x for 18x more dimensions. Verified.

capabilities.name: Robustness (handles perturbation/noise)
capabilities.notes: No NaN/Inf over 100k ticks with noise. Recovers from periodic perturbations. Verified.

capabilities.name: Real-time operation
capabilities.notes: The system operates at 10 Hz, updating state every 100ms. This is real-time for a cognitive architecture.

capabilities.name: Memory boundedness (doesn't grow without limit)
capabilities.notes: LTM grows linearly at 152 bytes/episode. Retrieval <400us. Verified.

capabilities.name: Experience / self-awareness
capabilities.notes: A cognitive mind module exists (Python), but experience is NOT claimed or verified. The system exhibits self-modeling (active inference over own state) but this is not experience.

capabilities.name: Natural language interaction
capabilities.notes: A language engine exists in the cognitive mind, but it's not benchmarked here. Not verified in this suite.

capabilities.name: Developmental trajectory (learns over lifetime)
capabilities.notes: The HPA axis is maturation-gated (CRH→ACTH→cortisol cascade activates as maturation increases). This is a developmental trajectory, but it's a single dimension, not a full developmental progression.
